news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹60.90 (up from ₹35.53 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹272.5b (up 22% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹10.4b (up 78% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 3.8% (up from 2.6% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 12%. Revenue is forecast to grow 7.7% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Construction industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 34% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Kalpataru Projects International Limited (NSEI:KPIL) has entered into share sale, exit, and release agreement to acquire remaining 35% stake in Kalpataru IBN Omairah Company Limited from BIN Omairah Contracting Company Limited for SAR 10 million.
news.body:
Kalpataru Projects International Limited (NSEI:KPIL) has entered into share sale, exit, and release agreement to acquire remaining 35% stake in Kalpataru IBN Omairah Company Limited from BIN Omairah Contracting Company Limited for SAR 10 million on February 23, 2026. The consideration will be paid by cash through banking channels. As part of the acquisition, Kalpataru Projects International Limited will acquire 175 equity shares representing 35% equity stake of Kalpataru IBN Omairah Company Limited. Upon completion, Kalpataru IBN Omairah Company Limited will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Kalpataru Projects International Limited. The acquisition will further strengthen the Company’s presence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia market.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹8.91 (up from ₹8.67 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹66.9b (up 17% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.52b (up 7.2% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.3% (down from 2.5% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 41%. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.4% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Construction industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 32% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
